newsitem.title: UK: Higher prices sideline UK meals and feeds buyers.
newsitem.headline: Higher prices sideline UK meals and feeds buyers.

text.p: Higher prices kept most buyers on the sidelines of the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday.
Firm Chicago futures coupled with a weaker sterling pushed higher protein soymeal up by around two stg a tonne.
"Buyers are looking for any excuse to do nothing and the currency gave it to them today," said one broker.
Only one trade was reported when citrus pulp pellets traded at 76 stg a tonne for spot ex-store Liverpool.
